title: Open the same canonical entity from drawing and directory
preconditions: Use the public CLI-authored PDF job/report ERD fixture from the browser test; report is drawn and job is directory-only.

steps.action: Open Data model and inspect its sidebar entity directory.
steps.expected_result: Application data, PDF job and PDF report are discoverable.

steps.action: Activate the report drawing by keyboard, close it, and activate the report directory explanation control.
steps.expected_result: Both open report revision r1; closing restores drawing focus and the undrawn proposed job remains in the directory.

steps.action: Repeat entity discovery from the currently assigned ERD named whiteboard and its directory, if provided; compare diagram/directory entity pins.
steps.expected_result: The current ERD entry exposes an expandable entity directory and both routes reach the same canonical definition; record a gap if the named-board surface only provides instance focus.

expected_result: The current ERD entry exposes an expandable entity directory and both routes reach the same canonical definition; record a gap if the named-board surface only provides instance focus.
